brief: Architect Copilot — Keystone. A fresh friendly low-poly miniature robot architect who functions as a tower unit. Character first. Oversized softly chamfered warm-ivory cuboid HEAD (roughly 40% total body height), wide deep-teal recessed FACE SCREEN with exactly two luminous cyan rounded rectangular EYES, one slightly raised eye for attentive curiosity; no mouth. Ivory shallow projecting top brow rim integrated into head. Head rear is plain ivory with ONE teal rectangular inset, no face on back. Signature DRAFTING COMPASS CREST mounted on crown: compact inverted-V comprising TWO thick ivory tapered beams with orange ends and ONE orange circular pivot with dark-teal center at apex, forming an open triangular space above head; crest width about 70% of head width, height about 45% of head height. Crown crest is a fitted accessory, not ears, horns or a large body arch. Compact deep-teal torso with ivory side shells, one small centered orange chest trapezoid partly covered by tablet. TWO short articulated teal upper arms and ivory forearms, each ending in one simple ivory mitten hand with a thumb and unified fingers. Both hands visibly hold the sides of ONE wide thick dark-teal BLUEPRINT TABLET in front of belly; tablet tilts up, cyan screen carries one simple white stepped architectural plan glyph. EXACTLY TWO short chunky legs ending in broad ivory wedge BOOTS with teal soles, firmly planted, slight outward stance. No platform/pedestal; freestanding robot companion. Orange ankle accents. Stubby proportions, friendly confident helpful expression, larger head and hands, clear head/body separation. Matte chunky bevels, economical low-poly planes, ivory/deep-teal/cyan/warm-orange palette, studio soft shadows. No buildings on body, no miniature city, no weapons, no cape, no hard hat, no pencil, no extra props, no text on model, no floating parts.

Top six cells Front, Front-Left, Left, Back, Back-Right, Right: corresponding reference views, consistent small size and ground level, no clipping. No faces on back. Lower left In-Game View: EXTREMELY ZOOMED OUT elevated isometric game landscape with winding path, green terrain, small server campus and trees. Notes exactly 'Expressive two-eye face', 'Compass crest and blueprint', 'Illustrative concept only'. No Game Name field, no invented UV data. No additional equipment. The reference image is the design source of truth.

The crest is an inverted V: TWO thick ivory tapered flat beams, orange lower tips, orange circular upper pivot with teal center. Preserve exact width/height and color arrangement. Large isolated assembled three-quarter crest at LEFT, useful small FRONT, SIDE and REAR views at upper right, fitted-context inset at bottom right showing its position on top of the exact ivory robot head with teal face and cyan eyes. Keep the solid teal pivot center (not a hole) and open triangular negative space below hinge. Small callouts 'Orange pivot', 'Ivory beams', 'Orange contact tips'. No separate tools, no extra straps, no screws, no hidden electronics, no exploded mechanism, no detachability claims, no invented dimensions. Show visible contact against head crown. Use same crisp chunky low-poly illustration and consistent studio lighting as reference.
